answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The garden lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the trellis is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
